title: Calibration prep: manager talking points & metric anchors
content:
Purpose / immediate goal:
- Quick, messy prep for calibration conversation and manager 1:1 next week. Not polished — notes to self.
- Focus: 6 concrete evidence points, 2 ask scenarios (raise vs role expansion), and fallback language if manager pushes back.

Key outcomes I want from the conversation:
- Clear decision timeline (date or sprint) for promotion/level change OR explicit list of gaps to close.
- Agreement on two visible, high-impact projects I can lead in next 12 weeks.
- Concrete support: 1 skip-level intro, sponsorship ask (name), and biweekly feedback checkpoints.

Topline signals (short bullets I can state):
- Performance: consistently exceeded goals on onboarding metric (time-to-onboard reduced by ~25% YoY for new ICs I mentored).
- Impact: Led cross-functional launch of onboarding playbook that reduced new-hire ramp time and improved first-quarter OKR delivery (see JIRA-HR-1983 summary).
- Scope: took on two projects that were previously exec-managed (hiring rubric + manager enablement content). Both delivered with measurable adoption.
- Coaching: 8 direct reports with documented growth plans; three promoted internally since 2025.
- Reliability: handled two unexpected escalations (privacy incident; vendor outage) and coordinated cross-team response — minimal customer impact and positive post-incident review.

Evidence to cite (specifics I will read aloud):
1) Onboarding playbook adoption: 78% of teams used the playbook in Q4 2025; average ramp down from 12 -> 9 weeks (internal tracker, see CONFLUENCE-6234 notes).
2) Mentorship outcomes: 3 mentees promoted to senior roles in <9 months; feedback snippets available in 1:1 notes folder.
3) Project ownership: Hiring rubric shipped (PR #77) with 90% hiring manager satisfaction score in pilot survey.
4) Ops stability: Incident response timeline and postmortem (linked) that reduced MTTR by ~30% for two incidents.
5) Speaker/enablement: Ran 4 cross-org manager enablement sessions with average survey rating 4.6/5.
6) Peer feedback: Summarized quotes from skip-levels and partners (copy-paste section below for quick read).

Quick script / opener for the manager 1:1:
- "I want to share a concise summary of work that demonstrates expanded scope and impact, and ask for your counsel on getting to the next level. I have two proposed paths and a timeline I think is realistic. Can we align on next steps today?"

Ask scenarios (two paths):
1) Promotion now (preferred)
- Rationale: documented impact, deliverables above, leadership across projects, promotable examples from direct reports.
- Ask: formal promotion to Senior People Partner (or equivalent) in the next calibration cycle; compensation band alignment; title update and updated role brief.
- Support needed: manager sponsorship for calibration, senior leader note, and one concrete example for calibrators.

2) Time-bound development + promotion (if not now)
- Rationale: If calibration feedback needs more runway, propose clear closed-loop plan.
- Plan: 12-week sprint with two deliverables (listed below), weekly check-ins, and a formal reevaluation at end of sprint.
- Deliverables: (A) Expand hiring rubric to cover manager-level competencies + run pilot with 3 teams; (B) Lead a cross-org manager coaching clinic and publish the playbook update with adoption metrics.

Fallback language / handling pushback:
- If manager says "not ready": ask which specific behaviors or outcomes they need to see, request examples, and set measurable milestones and check-in cadence.
- If manager asks for more data: offer to pull anonymized survey snippets and adoption metrics within 48 hours.
- If manager asks for a longer runway: negotiate for at least two formal sponsorship touches (skip-level and PM partner) and a mid-sprint review.

Concrete 12-week sprint (if needed):
Week 1-2: finalize rubric updates + align pilot partners
Week 3-6: run manager clinic + collect feedback
Week 7-10: iterate playbook and run adoption campaign
Week 11-12: compile metrics, prepare promotion packet for calibration

Phone-call / calibration-ready one-pager (items to attach):
- 1-paragraph impact summary (ready in doc: paste into email)
- 6 bullet evidence list (above)
- 2 short quotes from partners (copy lines below)
- List of deliverables and timeline for the sprint option

Two short partner quotes to use (copyable):
- "Amelia brought clarity and actionable steps to a messy hiring problem — hiring outcomes improved and managers are using the rubric every cycle." — Lena Gupta
- "When the vendor outage hit, Amelia coordinated across teams and kept execs informed; her calm leadership prevented customer escalation." — Ravi Menon

Open items / TODO (notes to self):
- Pull exact ramp numbers and the adoption dashboard (CONFLUENCE-6234) — target: screenshots by Monday.
- Export feedback snippets (anonymize) from 1:1 notes folder.
- Draft 1-paragraph promo summary and get quick read from Lena.
- Ask manager for preferred format for promotion packet (email vs doc) before the meeting.

Unresolved questions I want manager to clarify:
- Will calibration accept a 12-week development plan as a path to promotion, or do they prefer all evidence submitted at cycle time?
- Who is the recommended calibrator to speak to my growing scope (people leader or product partner)?

Final personal pep notes (short):
- Keep it factual and calm, anchor to outcomes, avoid emotional framing.
- Lead with impact and concrete asks.
- If they push back, convert friction into measurable next steps.

-- end of scratch — keep as draft for now.
